encode_string_to_bytes: encode a string to UTF-8 bytes using the grpc encode helper function
decode_bytes_to_string: decode UTF-8 bytes to a string using the grpc decode helper function
serialize_message: serialize a message using a custom serializer with exception handling via grpc serialize
deserialize_message: deserialize a serialized message using a custom deserializer with exception handling via grpc deserialize
build_fully_qualified_method: build a fully qualified gRPC method name from a service group and method name
